rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; Form 8960 (2025) p. 1, line 1, "Taxable interest (see instructions)" (the line 1 instructions are not among the pages given, as the model notes). Form 1040 line 2b copies Schedule B line 4, which is line 2 less line 3, and line 3 is zero because the savings bond interest exclusion (Form 8815) is refused by sb.unsupported; the floor at zero is a type wrapper. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f8960.json`, 1,786): 1,738 agree, no value difference; 10 project-refuses are the cited f8960.refund screen on line 1 (witnesses 0-2) and 38 project-unknown the same screen withheld (witnesses 6-8).

Ruling: scope; i8960 p. 22, Line 13: "If you didn't exclude any amounts from your gross income under section 911 and you don't own an interest in a CFC or PFIC, your MAGI is your AGI as reported on Form 1040 or 1040-SR." Form 1040 line 11b copies line 11a, so the candidate's line 11a is the same AGI (the project's line is sa.agi, which is line 11b). Triage (1,786): 1,742 agree, no value difference; 6 project-refuses are the cited f8960.refund screen on line 13 (witnesses 0-2), 33 project-unknown the same screen withheld, and 5 candidate-refuses upstream screens (sd.other_forms, div.bad_components, s179.multi) reached when the project stops at the withheld answer (witnesses 8, 13, 14).

Ruling: scope; Form 8960 (2025) p. 1, line 2, "Ordinary dividends (see instructions)". Form 1040 line 3b copies Schedule B line 6, the project's reference. Triage (1,786): 1,595 agree, no value difference; 22 candidate-refuses and 169 candidate-unknown come from the candidate's f8960.unsupported refusal on line 2 (witness 0, classm.f5695.6, refused return: project $0, candidate refuses; witness 2, table.band.first, screen withheld), a screen the project applies on lines 1, 3, 5b, 10 and 13. Section 404(k) dividends, which the candidate's note sends to that screen, are part of what f8960.unsupported asks ("another net investment income adjustment").

rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent representation; project retained. Both read line 9b as the state, local and foreign income tax allocable to net investment income, allowed only when itemizing. The second transcription caps the allocation at Schedule A line 5e; the project takes the supplied allocation and refuses the return through `f8960.bad_allocation` when the claimed allocation exceeds the Schedule A deduction, so within the non-refused scope the values agree. No change to the data.
